<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>U.N.A.M.DD — Bureau d'Exploration Technique</title>
    <!-- Bibliothèque de génération Word embarquée pour l'export hors-ligne -->
    <script src="https://unpkg.com"></script>
    <style>
        :root { 
            --primary: #0a2540; --secondary: #0052cc; --gold: #c5a059; 
            --background: #f4f6f9; --text: #1c2a38; --success: #10b981; --danger: #ef4444;
            --surface: #ffffff;
        }
        body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; background-color: var(--background); color: var(--text); margin: 0; padding: 12px; }
        .container { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); padding: 18px; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); box-sizing: border-box; }
        
        /* En-tête Corporate Pro */
        .header-main { text-align: center; padding: 15px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #0e3054 0%, #051424 100%); border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 4px solid var(--gold); }
        .header-main h1 { color: #ffffff; margin: 8px 0 2px 0; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; }
        .header-main p { color: var(--gold); margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 2px; }
        
        /* Rubriques professionnelles avec Filigrane U.N.A.M.DD */
        .section { 
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 18px; border-radius: 12px; background-color: var(--surface); margin-bottom: 18px; position: relative; overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
            background-image: url('data:image/png;base64,');
            background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: calc(100% - 15px) 15px; background-size: 55px;
        }
        .section h3 { color: var(--primary); margin: 0 0 15px 0; font-size: 15px; border-bottom: 2px solid #f1f5f9; padding-bottom: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; }
        
        .form-group { margin-bottom: 12px; }
        label { display: block; font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 13px; color: #475569; }
        input, select, textarea { width: 100%; padding: 11px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 16px; background: #fff; color: #1c2a38; }
        .grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
        
        table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 15px 0; font-size: 13px; background: #ffffff; }
        th, td { border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; padding: 10px 8px; text-align: left; }
        th { background-color: var(--primary); color: white; font-weight: 600; }
        tr:nth-child(even) { background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.01); }
        
        .btn { color: white; padding: 12px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .btn-primary { background-color: var(--secondary); }
        .btn-whatsapp { background-color: #25D366; }
        .score-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: bold; background: #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a; }
        
        .signature-container { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px; text-align: center; margin-top: 5px; }
        #canvasSignature { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; width: 100%; height: 110px; touch-action: none; }
